knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A swing is a signal to check the result. Retesting with an in-date kit and checking the equipment come before any action, and the plan decides the response.
A consistent point and time let results be compared across visits. That comparison is the trend the record exists to show.
When the plan does not cover a result, the response is a referral to the owner and a specialist. Guessing, changing several variables or recording nothing are all wrong.

practicalCriteria: Learner tests pH, ammonia, nitrite and nitrate on a training sample with an in-date kit, in the set order, and records each result with the time and temperature
Learner identifies an expired reagent and a meter with no current calibration, and records each as not valid
Learner responds to a simulated out-of-range result by retesting and checking the equipment, then changes one variable only as the plan directs
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Test record for the training sample, with time, temperature and method
Reagent expiry and meter calibration check
Response record with the retest and the single change made
Assessor observation of the test sequence
stopWorkCriteria: A reagent or meter that the learner uses without checking its status
A proposed large dose of any product to force a result
Several livestock showing distress with the plan not covering the response
